'''Ona Antilles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] who served in the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]. A member of the [[Antilles family (Galactic Alliance)|Antilles family]], Ona was the daughter of former [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] member [[Bail Antilles (Galactic Alliance)|Bail Antilles]].<ref name="Legacy 42" />

Lieutenant Antilles was present when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] delegation joined the fleet, and was temporarily second-in-command of the fleet after the attempted assassination of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]].<ref name="Legacy 42" />

When the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] set up its base in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], Antilles was promoted to be Admiral Stazi's personal aide. Antilles greeted [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]], who said they had to [[Rawk V99 blaster|weapons]] to sell to Stazi and that they desired to negotiate with the admiral in person. Their actual intent was to watch for any assassins sent by [[Vul Isen]] after the Admiral.<ref name="Legacy 49">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref> Syn spotted the [[Unidentified assassin (Gar Stazi)|assassin]] and dispatched him before he could kill Stazi. Antilles then advised the Admiral to quickly return to his flagship, to which he refused, as their wounded were in danger as well.<ref name="Legacy 50">[[Legacy (2006) 50|''Legacy'' (2006) 50]]</ref>
